effect.name: Colour Replace
effect.description: Swaps one colour in a sprite for another, within a tolerance. The palette-swap workhorse: one mushroom sheet, every mushroom in the game.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Find Colour
parameter.description: The colour to look for. Pick it with the eyedropper from your actual sprite; anti-aliased edges will need some tolerance.

parameter.name: Tolerance
parameter.description: How far a pixel can sit from Find Colour and still count. 0 is an exact match.

parameter.name: Edge Softness
parameter.description: Fades the swap out past the tolerance so anti-aliased edges do not turn into a hard rim.

parameter.name: Keep Shading
parameter.description: On, the replacement keeps the original pixel's light and shade, which holds up on shaded sprites.
